journey.name: Retry failed turn: run it again after reconnecting
journey.description: A turn that cannot reach the API shows an inline error with Retry rather than losing the message. Reconnecting and retrying produces the reply.

actions.action: Enable airplane mode on the device
Type "Reply with exactly: Hello" into the message field and tap send
Verify an error message about no network connection is displayed
Verify a "Retry" button is displayed below it
Disable airplane mode on the device
Wait until a reply bubble appears containing "Hello"
Verify the error message is no longer displayed
